attchmntText: Xelpmoc Design And Tech Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Xelpmoc Design and Tech Limited filed advertisements for its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, published on November 14, 2026. The Board approved the results on November 13, 2026. Standalone net loss was Rs 21,861.12 lakhs for the quarter and Rs 43,738.78 lakhs for six months. Consolidated net loss was Rs 22,080.37 lakhs for the quarter and Rs 43,477.7 lakhs for six months. Mehaitach Technology Limited reported standalone net profit of Rs 261.00 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated net profit was Rs 264.24 lakhs. Mcnally Bharat Engineering Company Limited reported standalone loss after tax of Rs 1,541.88 lakhs for the quarter. Consolidated loss after tax was Rs 660.56 lakhs. The company remains under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process.

attchmntText: Xelpmoc Design And Tech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Press Release   Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the second quarter and half ended September 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Xelpmoc Design and Tech Limited announced its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results. Consolidated revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 was Rs 8.6 million, compared to Rs 9.6 million in Q1 FY27 and Rs 7.6 million in Q2 FY26. Adjusted operating EBITDA for Q2 FY27 was negative Rs 18.1 million, compared to negative Rs 14.9 million in Q1 FY27 and negative Rs 16.1 million in Q2 FY26. The fair value of portfolio investments as on September 30, 2026, stands at approximately Rs 682.9 million. The press release is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Xelpmoc Design And Tech Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Xelpmoc Design and Tech Limited filed an investor presentation with the BSE and NSE on November 13, 2026. The filing covers financial performance for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The presentation outlines the company's business model involving startups and corporates. It highlights products including DocuXray, VideoXray, and RELY. The CEO emphasized focusing on revenue generation from the corporate sector. The goal is to achieve profitability by leveraging own products and services. The company operates as an innovation catalyst using design thinking, technology, and data science. Ventures include Woovly and others receiving institutional funding. The presentation contains forward-looking statements and disclaimers regarding accuracy and risks. Vaishali Shetty signed the letter as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Xelpmoc Design And Tech Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Xelpmoc Design and Tech Limited reported unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 13, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, standalone revenue from operations was Rs. 8,601.47 thousand, with total income of Rs. 9,323.76 thousand. Employee benefits expense stood at Rs. 20,319.44 thousand. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, standalone revenue from operations was Rs. 18,217.18 thousand, with total income of Rs. 21,043.52 thousand. The independent auditor issued a review report stating nothing came to their attention indicating material misstatements. The consolidated results include subsidiaries Signal Analytics Private Limited and Xelpmoc Design and Tech UK Limited. The report notes material uncertainties regarding the going concern status of Soultrax Studios Private Limited and Signal Technologies Private Limited.

attchmntText: Xelpmoc Design And Tech Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Xelpmoc Design and Tech Limited will announce financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. The company has scheduled an earnings call for investors and shareholders on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 16:00 hours IST. The call will run from 16:00 to 17:00 hours IST. Management representatives including Mr. Sandipan Chattopadhyay, Mr. Srinivas Koora, and Mr. Jaison Jose will address investors. Details are available on the company website.
